newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA LEV ENDS SOFTER AT 1,580-1,610 PER DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA LEV ENDS SOFTER AT 1,580-1,610 PER DOLLAR.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 1,580-1,610 per dollar, down from opening at 1,560-1,580 due to a rise in dollar demand on the interbank market, dealers said.
"Dollar demand from final clients picked up in the afternoon, pressuring the lev by 20 to 30 from morning levels. Trade was generally quiet," one dealer said.

Some banks took advantage of rising dollar demand to test lower levels for the lev near 1,620-1,640 but those offers met resistance from buyers and the lev consolidated in a narrow range around 1600 until the close. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
